study: Ansari & Pianta 2018 (NCRECE MyTeachingPartner pre-K coaching RCT, ECRQ 44)
eval_evidence: MTP is the developers' own program (MTP; Pianta et al.); Pianta is a co-author. NCRECE/CASTL (UVA) developer-conducted coaching trial.
developer_evidence: Coaches were 'hired as part of the study' and trained/supervised by NCRECE project staff (weekly reviews, biweekly calls, fidelity checks by NCRECE staff); the project's own coaching team delivered the intervention.
cascade_evidence: Project-employed/research-team coaches delivered the web-mediated MTP coaching directly to teachers under NCRECE staff supervision; coaches are the program's own delivery agents rather than an external trained-trainer tier.
counterfactual_evidence: Teachers randomly assigned to receive PD (treatment) or 'to go about their business as usual (i.e., control condition).'
coaching_evidence: Teachers participated in ~10 cycles of coaching across the school year (M = 10.23): videotaped own instruction, observation/feedback/reflection cycles -- roughly monthly+, individualized to the teacher's own classroom.
student_dose_evidence: Teacher coaching PD only; only the teacher's classroom interactions change. No direct student-facing tutoring/dose.
maturity_evidence: MTP coaching is delivered as one school year of coaching per teacher with end-of-year child outcomes; one-year dose with no multi-year maturity axis (teachers new to the coaching).
